children: GXO Logistics reported 2026 quarterly revenue of $3.59B, up 5.7% from $3.4B a year earlier. Net income increased 8.3% to $65M, while diluted EPS rose 9.8% to $0.56.
¹ Reported as “Revenue”. ² Reported as “Net income (loss)”. ³ Reported as “Earnings (loss) per share”.
Revenue grew 6.8% year to date, driven by new customer wins and increased activity with existing customers.
Growth was broad-based, with U.K. revenue up 7.6% and U.S. revenue up 5.6% in the quarter.
Technology and consumer electronics revenue rose 18.6%, while food and beverage revenue declined 5.4%.
Management cited expansion among technology and data center, aerospace and defense, industrials, and life sciences customers.
New customer start-ups and ramp-ups increased operating costs; productivity efforts and synergies from the Wincanton acquisition partly offset the pressure.
